rule: use as optional visual-effects layer; do not replace script, timing, subtitles, renderer governance, cover, rights, or QC

publicationReadyRequires: project-authored or explicitly licensed Galacean effect JSON/assets
reject: remote effect URLs without rights record
final exact Chinese text owned only by canvas/WebGL textures

capabilities.title: Particle atmosphere
capabilities.visualJob: add low-intensity mood, field motion, or invisible-system texture behind the main content
requiredAssets: effect json or local canvas recipe
capabilities.fallback: CSS radial dust or SVG particles frozen at low opacity
capabilities.rightsNotes: Effect recipe and textures must be project-authored or explicitly licensed.

capabilities.title: Firework payoff
capabilities.visualJob: mark a result, reward, conclusion, or achievement beat
requiredAssets: burst effect json or authored particle recipe
capabilities.fallback: deterministic SVG radial burst timed to the same cue
capabilities.rightsNotes: Do not copy third-party firework JSON without license and source.

capabilities.title: Energy beam reveal
capabilities.visualJob: connect two states, reveal a hidden idea, or guide gaze along a causal path
capabilities.fallback: SVG connector glow with CSS stroke animation
capabilities.rightsNotes: Beam texture must be local-authored or licensed.

capabilities.title: Path trail trace
capabilities.visualJob: show a path, workflow, route, cursor movement, or timeline flow
requiredAssets: trail effect json or authored particle recipe
capabilities.fallback: SVG path stroke reveal with CSS/WAAPI
capabilities.rightsNotes: Path geometry is generated from the scene plan, not copied from reference visuals.

capabilities.title: Focus scan and spotlight
capabilities.visualJob: diagnose, search, select, or focus viewer attention on one object
requiredAssets: scanline/ring effect json or local shader recipe
capabilities.fallback: CSS conic-gradient ring or SVG scanline
capabilities.rightsNotes: Avoid any medical/security-interface copied art direction unless licensed and abstracted.

capabilities.title: Transition burst
capabilities.visualJob: make scene changes, chapter shifts, or mental-state transitions feel intentional
capabilities.fallback: CSS/SVG mask wipe or crossfade with recorded degraded effect
capabilities.rightsNotes: No remote transition pack without explicit usage rights.

capabilities.title: Depth orbit and 3D field
capabilities.visualJob: explain spatial hierarchy, platform architecture, invisible relation, or orbital system
requiredAssets: effect json or Three.js/Galacean-compatible scene recipe
capabilities.fallback: 2D layered parallax field with deterministic labels
capabilities.rightsNotes: 3D models/textures require explicit source and license.

capabilities.title: UI activation sparkle
capabilities.visualJob: make a click, toggle, generated result, or product-state change feel responsive
requiredAssets: small sparkle effect json or local particle recipe
requiredEvidence: effect stays out of caption band
capabilities.fallback: CSS box-shadow pulse and small SVG sparks
capabilities.rightsNotes: Do not use branded UI or copied product animation unless it belongs to the project.

capabilities.title: Ambient falling elements
capabilities.visualJob: show context, pressure, seasonality, data noise, or environmental mood
requiredAssets: sprite texture or procedural shape recipe
capabilities.rightsNotes: Sprite textures must be original or licensed.

capabilities.title: Texture and video plane
capabilities.visualJob: place a media texture or generated plate inside a controlled effect scene
capabilities.fallback: flat HTML/SVG media plate with CSS transform
capabilities.rightsNotes: The texture/media rights record is mandatory before render.

capabilities.title: Spine character motion
capabilities.visualJob: animate an authorized character rig as a short supporting foreground actor
capabilities.fallback: static authorized character plate with CSS pose emphasis
capabilities.rightsNotes: Requires explicit Spine asset rights and must not imitate protected characters.

capabilities.title: Rich text effect plate
capabilities.visualJob: create a stylized decorative text plate for non-critical copy while deterministic overlays own final claims
requiredAssets: deterministic overlay for any final exact text
capabilities.fallback: HTML/CSS kinetic type with exact text ownership
capabilities.rightsNotes: Do not delegate final readable Chinese text to effect textures.
